house.name: Dover Haven
house.description: Unit 4, Dover Mews, 2nd Avenue — three bedrooms, three bathrooms and a study, four minutes on foot from Dover Beach.

pois.name: Dover Beach
pois.description: Calm, swimmable water with a lifeguard on duty and plenty of natural shade. Down 2nd Avenue, then along Dover Road to the beach access — flat the whole way.

pois.name: South Coast Boardwalk
pois.timeLabel: Starts near the end of the road
pois.description: Runs about a mile and a half from Rockley to Accra along the coast. The best thing to do at seven in the morning, before it gets hot.

pois.name: St Lawrence Gap
pois.description: Restaurants, rum shops and live music — somewhere to eat at almost any hour. Lively in the evening, quiet again by the time you're back in bed.

pois.name: Oistins Fish Fry
pois.description: Go on a Friday night for the fish fry — it's the one thing everybody tells guests to do, and they're right.

pois.name: Supermarket
pois.description: The nearest full supermarket for a proper grocery run before settling in. Update the pin with the exact store once confirmed.

pois.name: Corner Shop
pois.description: A smaller shop nearby for milk, bread and the things you don't want to drive for. Update the pin with the exact shop once confirmed.

pois.name: Grantley Adams Airport
pois.description: A transfer can be arranged in advance — just ask when you book.

pois.name: Route Taxis & ZR Vans
pois.description: Run constantly and cost a couple of dollars — the fastest way to Oistins or Bridgetown if you don't mind a squeeze and loud soca.
